quote_text: The biggest win wasn't fewer comments. It was seeing which launch assets were still blocked and who actually needed to sign off.
Before AtlasFlow Review, our launch files moved through inboxes and chats. The product gave us one review path instead of four conflicting ones.
Leadership finally had a clean readiness summary without asking every regional team for a manual status update.
AtlasFlow Review helped us cut the last-minute approval churn, but we still keep external agency review in a separate system.
The product feels strongest when regional launch teams need clarity on status, dependencies, and the exact next approver.
